Items.Description: Original hot-lapping dash in a livery look: a huge gear, a hero delta with tape, predicted, last and best lap, sector splits and tyre temperatures as colour blocks, and a settings strip.

Items.Name: NOCTURNE Red
Items.Author: FX Unleashed
Items.Description: NOCTURNE in red: night endurance, modelled and rendered in 3D. A turbine lens for the gear and delta, glass fuel and energy cylinders, a timing tower with class colours, race clock, flags and a race-progress bar whose colour follows the day. Made for the screen's RAM drive.

Made for the screen's RAM drive.

Items.Name: HALO
Items.Author: FX Unleashed
Items.Description: Original hot-lapping dash: the gear in a brushed-metal halo whose ring glows with your delta, chamfered plates for delta, predicted, last and best lap, sector splits and a tyre heat map, with your settings at a glance.

Items.Name: APEX
Items.Author: FX Unleashed
Items.Description: Original hot-lapping dash: delta to best with a delta bar, predicted lap, live sector splits against your best lap, tyre temperatures and pressures, and your settings at a glance.
